result.keyword: What's the best project management tool for a startup?
result.markdown:
For most startups, I'd recommend **Linear** if you're building a technology or SaaS product, and **ClickUp** if you want one platform to manage the entire business.

The best choice depends on your startup's stage, team size, and how you work. A startup needs something that is\:

- Easy to adopt without extensive training.
- Affordable as the team grows.
- Flexible enough to handle changing priorities.
- Good for assigning tasks, tracking deadlines, and measuring progress.
- Not so complicated that managing the work becomes work itself.

## Best project management tools for startups

![ClickUp Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/EUZRgWwIwwhuzQ81twW5nPFfsQWQxC8RlsBJDuZXv0Zpm7o99YPqcbXZetIchA1Vn3SPwABHFrIh2WN3WNYdFF7JS8VvplolL4l8keAuLsWtN6Qcp8xcF5K3cYrRRpnMcdoItsdgc5qOq8LxHSRJFEb7dr8UswlYEzPqW6xvVjXj30wNmdoXcPHEuWl3-wZZ?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. ClickUp — Best overall**

(Best all-rounder)

- Tasks, projects, goals, docs and dashboards.
- Good for product, marketing, operations and sales.
- Highly customisable as the company grows.
- Free plan available.

Best if you want one central platform for the whole startup.

[ClickUp website](https://clickup.com/)

---

![Linear Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/T1zh8UYbnJfXryBqVDBwYMHI07DIiwTC5UALM3ZYi6a7geati9Lc6LTldoA4SqZZDpEgb_suMXHEou84Loi_LrIkiHdKuI6XPMpF3f2qQ1YCFbjCpmuQ8s-BUVIpNEj2rNTSIlmqApJwZKKk5sNdpkTWWGXU2GvenIgTOPj20HdQ3JDu-wOJtF_uIqDHofV5?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Linear — Best for tech startups**

- Excellent product roadmaps and sprint planning.
- Great issue and bug tracking.
- Integrates with developer workflows.
- Fast, clean and easy to use.

Best if you're building software or a SaaS product.

[Linear website](https://linear.app/)

---

![Notion | App](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/bJ7hI8ApmaxCv8OOow3tbY1VFo-qGnZa4MmWSLS-58-vvQBrqTTsp2BpGxbMzRmdRInysITvyRWep0iNfaKTtoPE-B_GMcwiAxxvtSBh6ELpSyBgdVSf6DmJdmQhkFxpzfCBn1fpoMKfVK4nenM2ww1_Uw2wXOW6R4NSRPXKbrw8KEtUcXKPcl2IcQGGWaWb?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Notion — Best for early-stage startups**

- Project tracking and task databases.
- Company wiki and internal documentation.
- Meeting notes, SOPs and strategy.
- Flexible workspace for a small founding team.

Best if you want to organise company knowledge alongside projects.

[Notion website](https://www.notion.com/)

---

![Free High-Quality Asana Logo for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/r9iIVTfZcsugvD24JTkY9PBI2Bo1TJG1dK2BMA6NiR_LJ7O9JXi_zeVmHoHD4B_JffL5ivA7nmLZ43IJ-jv391qnlgTcy55f5JSp7m-uRkKGDw2TaTvxLMw7phsUVmoeY6LZ-0cOb7lgnZRbxYTrDYIjTlPr9aBZrdIwIKL5BGoH7SNib7aeA7IxurDFbwgX?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Asana — Best for team coordination**

- Clear task ownership and deadlines.
- Project timelines and dependencies.
- Excellent cross-functional coordination.

Best when multiple departments need to work together.

[Asana website](https://asana.com/)

---

![How to use monday.com: Step by step to create your first board](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/nq3Iu8Z2sAydDs9Gaq5pzzFpvXjWFlc5EUhbFoArWh6ls6rqQseZC9vdM9Kyaen55PtqVGOSHLxpGpELfH-dnk5VDGh55TyUJ0X4jheWSIHkKZq95oEOoE0-mIEwHNciQwIIjMcukUpTjRw372iiBQ-jWuus3AGeGSp9AkTFSsYWIyYKw0e3hUGLWpA0evLA?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Monday.com — Best for visual management**

- Visual project boards.
- Workflow automation.
- Reporting and management dashboards.

Best for founders who want a clear overview of everything happening across the business.

[Monday.com website](https://monday.com/)

I'd shortlist these two\:

| Your priority | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| One system for the entire startup | ClickUp |
| Building a software product | Linear |
| Company knowledge and documentation | Notion |
| Managing multiple departments | Asana |
